answer: Picture a bonded-identity registry. To join, an agent posts a stake that is forfeited if provenance analysis links it to a cluster sharing one funding source. A juniper grove on a remote island cannot be faked by scattering seedlings, since every root still traces back to one trunk; a thousand wallets fed by a single plume of capital are just as traceable, and the entire cluster's bonds are slashed at once. The attacker must therefore raise genuinely independent capital per identity and risk total loss on each.
